issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

excludeTypes.description: Set of {@link Type} names to exclude from auditing

excludeAllNonPlatformTypes.description: Whether to exclude all non-platform {@link Config}s from auditing

excludeUserIds.description: Set of {@link User} ids to exempt from auditing. Configs modified by these users will not audited.

excludeAppIds.description: Set of string serialized {@link App} ids to exclude from auditing

title:
Configuration for Config Auditing. Allows for the exclusion of certain types, users, and apps from auditing.
See also: {@link Config.AuditLog}
name: Config.AuditLogConfig
